objective: Prepare an isolated Hyperledger Caliper controller for user-operated manual testing of the live SEBA-XAI Fabric network

executionBoundary.reason: The user requested setup only and will start testing manually.

postSetupCorrection.trigger: Two initial user-operated runs exposed a semantic transaction-monitor configuration error that static parsing did not detect.
postSetupCorrection.change: Removed the optional transaction logging monitor and made the run wrapper require zero failed rounds, an HTML report, a parseable performance summary, and zero failed Fabric transactions for smoke-test completion.

dependencyIntegrityCorrection.observed: The earlier Caliper binding command rewrote the installed @grpc/grpc-js package contents to 1.13.1 even though the lockfile resolved 1.14.4.
dependencyIntegrityCorrection.change: A clean pinned npm ci restored 1.14.4, the binding is now declarative through package dependencies, and installation validation reads the actual installed package files.

limitations: The prepared smoke test validates connectivity only and is not a formal benchmark.
Single-host measurements cannot establish distributed or multi-site scalability.
A valid paper comparison still requires matched baseline, proposed-method, and ablation runs.
Caliper 0.7.1 retains known transitive dependency findings documented in the audit artifact.
